$comment: The cinematics storyboard as data (docs/cinematics/storyboard.md is the page; docs/cinematics/README.md the workflow). `pnpm video -- estimate` prices this file and `pnpm video -- generate --shot <id> --stage <explore|final>` sends one shot from it, only with --spend and a key, and only inside the $150 cap fixed in tools/src/video/budget.ts. `capture` is read by `pnpm stills:cinematics`, which photographs each `still` through the real game. Every prompt gets the standing content rules appended (tools/src/video/request.ts, CONTENT_RULES_SUFFIX).

shots.title: Dawn on the wall -- Qarn Hadid's rock wall and its road gate
shots.prompt: Animate this still from a stylised real-time strategy game. Keep the high three-quarter overhead camera angle, the game's art style, every building and the layout of the ground exactly as in the image; nothing new enters the frame. A very slow push-in toward the gap in the rock wall where the road passes through. Low dawn light rises across the plain, long shadows shorten a little, a thin ground haze drifts left to right and thins as the light grows.
